questions: Are overlapping triples allowed? For example, in 'ABABC', can (1,2,3) and (1,2,5) both be counted, even though they share the same i and j?
If the same character at a position can serve as part of multiple triples (e.g., 'A' at index 1 used with different B and C later), are all such combinations counted separately?
Should the function count only distinct triples of indices, or is it simply counting all valid (i,j,k) combinations?
Is the order strictly A then B then C, or are we looking for any permutation where A, B, C appear in some order?
What if S contains characters other than A, B, C? Are they ignored, or do they affect the indexing?
Does the output need to be the count of triples, or should it list the triples themselves?
If there are multiple occurrences of A, B, C, do we consider every combination of one A, one B, one C that satisfies i<j<k?
Are we to assume 1-based indexing as given in the conditions, or should the implementation use 0-based indexing internally and adjust?
